MS in Computer Science (Thesis) - Funding
The department offers a limited number of teaching assistantships and research assistantships on a competitive basis. Funding is not guaranteed for master's students. Assistantships, when offered, include a tuition waiver and a monthly stipend.

English Language Proficiency
Applicants whose first language is not English must submit TOEFL iBT (minimum 90) or IELTS Academic (minimum 7.0) scores. No other tests are accepted.

MSc in Applied Computing
This program is open to Canadian citizens and permanent residents only. International applicants are not considered for admission to this program.

PhD in Physics
All admitted PhD students receive full funding for five years, including full tuition remission and a stipend of $38,500 per year.
Application deadline for Fall 2023 admission: December 1, 2022.
